subject: Re: Private offer rate harmonization + channel waterfall (Azure)
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@cloudvantage.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private offer rate harmonization + channel waterfall (Azure)

Tom — quick note following the call this morning. AsterCloud is asking for a cleaner view of how the private offer list price maps to the reseller channel waterfall so they can model margin to their end customers. We want to avoid bespoke pass-throughs per SKU if possible.

Attached is a working spreadsheet (RDW_AZ_PrivateOffer_Tiers_v3.xlsx) with:
- three candidate list-price bands (standard / growth / enterprise)
- suggested reseller % by band (tiered)
- a sample invoice routing note

Asks:
1) Can CloudVantage confirm they can accept a single waterfall (percentage passback by band) rather than per-SKU overrides?
2) If not, what minimal SKU exceptions are required for your top 10 customers?
3) Timing: we need a final waterfall to include in the PO by EOD Thursday (2027-10-07).

Irene/Ben — looped you for ops and channel check. If there are tax or listing complications, call them out in-line.

Thanks,
Sergio
Director, Marketplace Sales
Redwood Inference

---

From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@cloudvantage.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@astercloud.com
Date: 2027-10-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer rate harmonization + channel waterfall (Azure)

Sergio — thanks for the spreadsheet. High-level response: CloudVantage prefers a single waterfall per offer (by list-price band) for accounting simplicity, but two SKUs will likely need carve-outs because of legacy reseller agreements (Analytics add-on and SecureConnect).

On the timeline, EOD Thursday is tight for us but doable if we get the final band definitions by Wednesday EOD. I’ll ask procurement to flag the two carve-out SKUs and provide the minimal metadata required (SKU ID, current list, suggested passback %) by tomorrow 10/04.

Also note: our finance team will want the reseller % expressed as net-of-tax for the channel waterfall — do you have a recommended field in your PO template for that?

—Tom
VP Channel, CloudVantage

---

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@cloudvantage.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer rate harmonization + channel waterfall (Azure)

Tom — quick follow from ops: we can capture reseller % net-of-tax in the PO metadata (we add a channelWaterfall.taxTreatment field on our side). For invoice routing, we need CloudVantage to indicate whether they will invoice Redwood (pass-through) or invoice AsterCloud directly; the waterfall behaves the same but invoicing affects accounting treatment.

Ben — can you confirm if our billing system supports two SKU exceptions on a single private offer? If not, we should map the carve-outs to add-on SKUs and treat them as separate line-items in the PO.

Irene
Sr. Product Ops
Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@cloudvantage.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer rate harmonization + channel waterfall (Azure)

We can support two SKU exceptions in the PO as separate add-on lines. The platform treats add-ons as linked to the main offer for usage metering, so no extra integration work required. Only caution: add-on lines will appear as separate invoice rows which some end-customers (AsterCloud) might view differently for seat vs metered billing.

Tom — if you can send the SKU IDs and the desired passback % by EOD tomorrow I’ll slot them into the spreadsheet and produce a final Channel_Waterfall_Draft.pdf for sign-off.

Ben
Head of Marketplace Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: [RDW_AZ_PrivateOffer_Tiers_v3.xlsx], [Channel_Waterfall_Draft.pdf]

From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@cloudvantage.com>

Subject: Re: Private offer rate harmonization + channel waterfall (Azure)

On Mon, Oct 4, 2027 at 10:21 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> We can support two SKU exceptions in the PO as separate add-on lines.
> Ben

Agree — attaching our carve-out list. Two SKUs below plus suggested passback (net of tax):
- CV-ANALYTICS-XL — current list $1,200/mo — suggested passback 18%
- CV-SC-CONNECT — current list $450/mo — suggested passback 12%

Procurement also asked for a minimal certification that private offer traffic is isolated (we provide an ops note below). We’ll also need a clause that prevents unilateral list price changes for 180 days post-PO effective date.

Attaching: CloudVantage_Carveouts_20271004.csv (stub)

Tom

Thanks all — this is helpful. Next steps:
- Ben to finalize the two add-on SKUs in the RDW_AZ_PrivateOffer_Tiers_v3.xlsx and publish Channel_Waterfall_Draft.pdf (by 10/05 end-of-day) — Ben, noted on invoice rows callout for AsterCloud.
- Tom to review and confirm isolation note and the 180-day list-price protection language. If CloudVantage is OK, we’ll bake that into the PO terms.
- Naomi (finance) to review waterfall net-of-tax treatment and confirm accounting impact before we send to AsterCloud procurement.

Tom — can you confirm whether CloudVantage will invoice Redwood or AsterCloud by COB tomorrow? If they invoice AsterCloud directly we’ll add a short routing note in the PO; if Redwood invoices then we'll route the passback as a credit on the Redwood invoice.

Meeting offered if needed: Wednesday 10/06 09:00–09:30 PT to ratify waterfall and finalize PO language. Please confirm.

Sergio
Director, Marketplace Sales
Redwood Inference
